question_text:
Construct a trace table for this Python code, showing k and all four list values initially, after each loop body, and after the final assignment.

values=[3,2,6,1]
k=0
while k < 3:
    k+=1
    values[k]=values[k-1]+values[k]
values[0]=values[k]-values[0]
adaptation_rationale: Preserves dependent in-place updates and post-loop assignment; different list and final operation in Python.
